title: 형사소송비용 등에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Overseas Travel by Witnesses, etc.)
(1) Daily allowances, travel expenses, and accommodation expenses for witnesses, etc. under Article 6 of the Act shall be paid where witnesses, etc. travel from abroad to the Republic of Korea, from the Republic of Korea to abroad, or within a foreign country for the purpose of entering the Republic of Korea (hereinafter collectively referred to as "overseas travel").
(2) Fares for overseas travel by witnesses, etc. shall be classified as follows, and any applicable transit tax shall be added:
1. For railway and ship fares, fares at or below the intermediate class where fares are divided into classes; where there is no class distinction, the actual cost of boarding the train or vessel;
2. For motor vehicle fares, the actual expenses incurred;
3. For airfares, the amount prescribed for other persons in the Fixed Rates of Overseas Airfares in Attached Table 3 under Article 12 (2) of the Rules on Travel Expenses for Court Officials.
(3) Travel expenses other than fares, and accommodation expenses, for overseas travel by witnesses, etc. shall be the amounts prescribed for persons falling under category 2 (b) of the Classification Table for Travel Expense Payments in Attached Table 1, as specified in the Fixed Rates of Overseas Travel Expenses in Attached Table 4 under Article 16 (1) of the Rules on Travel Expenses for Court Officials. <Amended on Jan. 9, 2009>
